title: Finite stalk detection and Frobenius compatibility for lisse global sections
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $\mathcal G$ be a lisse $\Omega$-Weil sheaf, with lisse understood in [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves] and Weil structure in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $A=\Gamma(Y,\mathcal G)$ be ordinary global sections and let $T$ be the geometric Frobenius induced by its Weil structure, as in [def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius]. There is a finite family of closed points $y_1,\ldots,y_m$ of $Y_0$, not necessarily distinct, with geometric lifts $\bar y_i$ to $Y$ (distinct indices may carry the same closed point with different lifts), such that the evaluation map
$$A\longrightarrow\prod_{i=1}^m\mathcal G_{\bar y_i}$$
is injective. In particular $A$ is finite-dimensional over $\Omega$, and $T$ is a linear automorphism. The empty family is permitted for $Y=\varnothing$. For every closed point $y$ of $Y_0$ and chosen geometric lift $\bar y$, put $d=[\kappa(y):k_0]\ge1$. With $F_y$ the local geometric Frobenius [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], evaluation satisfies
$$\operatorname{ev}_{\bar y}(T^d a)=F_y\bigl(\operatorname{ev}_{\bar y}(a)\bigr)\quad(a\in A).$$
